newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Avmin Konkola deal to be signed shortly.
newsitem.headline: Avmin Konkola deal to be signed shortly.

text.p: An option agreement with Avmin Ltd on the development of the Konkola North copper mine will be signed shortly by the Zambian government and the company, parent group Anglovaal Ltd said on Thursday.
The development of the Konkola ore body on the Zambian Copperbelt is seen as crucial to the future of the country's mining industry.

Last month, a consortium led by Zambia Copper Investments, a subsidiary of Anglo American Corp of South Africa, signed an agreement with the Zambian government on the development of Konkola Deep mine.
Avmin is also leading a consortium bid for the prized Nkana and Nchanga divisions of Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines (ZCCM), which account for half of the national copper output.
